keyed.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.bad.0: The guests from {FACTION} left with a list. It was not a shopping list.
keyed.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.bad.1: {NAME} promised to tell everyone about the {ROOM}. That is the problem.
keyed.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.bad.2: A stay to forget, if {FACTION} lets anyone forget it.
keyed.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.fine.0: The guests from {FACTION} left. It happened, and that is about all.
keyed.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.fine.1: A stay of the kind nobody writes home about. {NAME} wrote home anyway.

keyed.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.good.1: A pleasant stay. Nobody complained loudly enough to count.
keyed.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.good.2: {NAME} called the {ROOM} "honest", which from {FACTION} is a compliment.
keyed.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.great.0: The guests from {FACTION} left glowing. One of them hugged the doorframe.
keyed.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.great.1: {FACTION} will be talking about this stay for a while, mostly in a good way.
keyed.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.great.2: A flawless stay. {NAME} asked whether the {ROOM} could be booked again "for life".
keyed.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.poor.0: The guests from {FACTION} left early in spirit and on time in body.
keyed.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.poor.1: {NAME} described the {ROOM} with a word our clerk refused to write down.
keyed.HH.Inn.Report.Opener.poor.2: Not a disaster. Not a stay you would put on a sign, either.
keyed.HH.Inn.Report.SentAway: You asked them to leave. They did, with the expression people use for that.
keyed.HH.Inn.Report.Temperature: The weather sent them home early.

keyed.HH.Setting.inn.arrivalNotice.Desc: A short letter for your first groups, a quiet message afterwards.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.arrivalRate.Desc: Multiplier on how often guest groups arrive. 1 = the normal rhythm of your difficulty; 0 stops new arrivals.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.autoWing.Desc: The first guest bed creates Guest Wing 1 around its room; later guest rooms join the nearest wing.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.cardThreshold.Desc: Guests from industrial or more advanced factions with a budget above this pay by card instead of carrying silver.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.checkInHour.Desc: Overnight guests plan to arrive from this hour on.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.checkOutHour.Desc: Overnight guests leave around this hour on their last morning.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.convertPower.Desc: How strongly a talk in the 'Convert' handling shakes a guest's certainty in their own ideoligion (100 % = the usual strength). Needs the Ideology DLC.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.coupleWish: Couples wish for a double bed
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.coupleWish.Desc: Couples who arrive together prefer one double bed. Getting it cheers them up a little, ending up in two single beds annoys them a little. Never changes prices.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.dayVisitors.Desc: Groups that only come for your open venues during opening hours and leave before closing time. Needs at least one venue sign.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.deskCloseHour.Desc: From this hour the front desk is an honesty box: guests check themselves in and pay a little less.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.deskOpenHour.Desc: From this hour a host can check guests in at the front desk. Outside the hours the desk works as an honesty box.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.doubleBedFactor.Desc: A bed for two earns this many times the price of a single bed. A couple in one double bed pays it together, each half, so they pay less than for two singles.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.expectationOffset.Desc: Added to every guest's expectation (0 … 1). Higher means harder to please.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.firstGuestMaxDays.Desc: Days after your first guest bed (or venue) by which the very first group will have arrived.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.firstGuestMinDays.Desc: Days after your first guest bed (or venue) until the very first group can arrive.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.forecastDays.Desc: How far ahead the arrival plan is drawn up (shown in the guest overview).
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.goodwillCapQuadrum.Desc: Hosting can raise a faction's goodwill by at most this much per quadrum.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.goodwillCeiling.Desc: Hosting alone never lifts a faction above this goodwill (75 = ally threshold).
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.goodwillLossCap: Largest goodwill loss per bad stay
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.goodwillLossCap.Desc: A bad stay costs a faction at most this much goodwill.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.groupDevGizmos.Desc: In dev mode, the DEV buttons of Hearth & Harbor buildings are folded into one 'Dev: Hearth & Harbor' button so the gizmo row stays readable. Vanilla and other mods' buttons are never touched.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.guestMoney.Desc: Multiplier on how much silver guests bring.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.honestyDiscount.Desc: Guests who check in at the unattended front desk (outside its hours) pay this much less per night.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.insultBase.Desc: Base chance that a recruitment talk offends the guest (lower with better social skill).
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.leaveEarly.Desc: Guests who are miserable for a long time, or run out of money, pack up before their planned day.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.leavingGifts.Desc: Happy guests sometimes leave a small gift at the front desk (more likely the better the stay).
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.maxGroupSize.Desc: No group brings more guests than this. Overnight groups are also limited by your free guest beds.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.podDistance.Desc: Guests of industrial or better factions arrive by drop pod when the walk from the map edge would be longer than this many cells.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.priceBase.Desc: Price of an economy bed for one night. Better rooms, beds and private rooms multiply it (shown on every guest bed).
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.priceTolerance.Desc: How much over their comfort price guests are still willing to pay.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.renownLossCap.Desc: One unhappy group lowers your renown by at most this much.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.reportMode.Desc: How the short report after each stay reaches you: as a letter, as a quiet message, or not at all.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.returnPinCap.Desc: Guests who plan to come back are kept as world pawns until their visit. Above this many, the oldest planned return visits are dropped.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.returnVisits.Desc: Guests who liked their stay come back after 3 to 10 days (unhappy ones after 14 to 30), plus twice their travel time.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.stayNightsMax.Desc: Overnight guests stay at most this many nights.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.stayNightsMin.Desc: Overnight guests stay at least this many nights.
keyed.HH.Setting.inn.waitThoughts.Desc: Guests who wait in vain or ring the night bell with nobody coming feel it in their mood; a waiting room softens it.

defs.ThingDef/HH_FrontDesk.description: A counter with a ledger, a bell and a pen on a string. Arriving guests check in here, pay their first night and are given a bed. The day's takings are put down beside it at midnight.\n\nWithout a front desk guests find their rooms on their own, which they do with visible reluctance.

defs.FleckDef/HH_Fleck_Life_Sparkle.descripti: A sparkle around a five-star review.

defs.FleckDef/HH_Fleck_Life_Heart.description: A small heart when a couple lies down in their shared bed.

defs.FleckDef/HH_Fleck_Life_Stars1.descriptio: The guest's review: 1 of 5 stars above the head.
defs.FleckDef/HH_Fleck_Life_Stars2.label: 2-star review
defs.FleckDef/HH_Fleck_Life_Stars2.descriptio: The guest's review: 2 of 5 stars above the head.
defs.FleckDef/HH_Fleck_Life_Stars3.label: 3-star review
defs.FleckDef/HH_Fleck_Life_Stars3.descriptio: The guest's review: 3 of 5 stars above the head.
defs.FleckDef/HH_Fleck_Life_Stars4.label: 4-star review
defs.FleckDef/HH_Fleck_Life_Stars4.descriptio: The guest's review: 4 of 5 stars above the head.
defs.FleckDef/HH_Fleck_Life_Stars5.label: 5-star review
defs.FleckDef/HH_Fleck_Life_Stars5.descriptio: The guest's review: 5 of 5 stars above the head.
I paid for that? I have slept better in a ditch, and the ditch did not charge.
The room was below what I expected. Well below.
The room was fine, if you squint.
A proper bed and a door that closes. That is all I ask.
A lovely room. I slept well.
A room like that makes the whole journey worth it.
One of the hosts kept me company. We talked about the weather. At length.
One of the hosts showed me around and kept me company.
The host was a delight. I may have laughed out loud.
I have not been looked after this well in years.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_GuestPestered.stages.0.des: I came here to sleep, not to be recruited.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_GuestPreached.stages.0.des: I came here to sleep, not to be talked out of my beliefs.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_HostedWell.stages.0.label: good talks
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_HostedWell.stages.0.descri: We have had some good conversations.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_GuestWaited.stages.0.label: waited a little
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_GuestWaited.stages.0.descr: I had to wait to be served. Not long, but I noticed.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_GuestWaited.stages.1.label: waited for nothing
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_GuestWaited.stages.1.descr: I waited and waited, and nobody came to serve me.
At least there was somewhere to sit while I waited.
The waiting room was comfortable enough.
Waiting there was almost a pleasure.
I would not have minded waiting longer in a room like that.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_SleptTogether.stages.0.des: One big bed for the two of us. That is all I wanted from this trip.
defs.ThoughtDef/HH_WantedDoubleBed.stages.0.d: We asked for one bed for the two of us and got two narrow ones. Cosy it is not.
